src/components/layout/pane/header.tsx.why: The title bar's inset for the window controls comes from the shell's header geometry, which the terminal shares, in cells.

src/components/layout/pane/sizing.ts.why: Panes receive their size in cells (PaneProps); this gives the desktop's taller chrome row in those cells.

src/components/layout/shell/drag/slide.t.why: A dragged pane moves by offsets of the saved layout, which is kept in cells.

src/components/layout/shell/pane/layers..why: Pane rectangles in the saved layout are in cells; this is where they become pixels.

src/components/ui/select-button.tsx.why: A select's width is given in cells by the pane, as its terminal button's is.

src/renderers/dom/data-table/dom.ts.why: The table's scroll and pointer API speaks rows and columns to callers shared with the terminal (j/k, paging, visible range); a row of text is one line tall.

src/renderers/dom/data-table/index.tsx.why: Every pane gives preferred column widths and resize minima in cells (DataTableColumn.width and minWidth), and rows are one line tall: the horizontal extent, the overflow decision, virtualization and paging follow from them.

src/renderers/dom/data-table/row.tsx.why: Column widths and gaps are cells in the column model every pane uses; a row is one line tall.

src/renderers/dom/desktop/controls.tsx.why: Callers give a button's size in cells; a framed field keeps its text one cell off its frame, as the terminal's does.

src/renderers/dom/desktop/list-view.tsx.why: The caller gives a list's height in rows.

src/renderers/dom/desktop/query-bar.tsx.why: The pane gives its search field's width in cells.

src/renderers/dom/desktop/select-field.t.why: An inline select is one row tall, the row it sits in.

src/renderers/dom/dom-ui-host.tsx.why: Exposes the cell size to components that still size in cells (chart bitmaps, the company logo).

src/renderers/dom/host/input.tsx.why: Callers give a field's width and height in cells; a one-line field is one row tall.

src/renderers/dom/host/live-frame.ts.why: A resize's live frame is in cells, the pane's unit, until the pane renders at the new size.

src/renderers/dom/host/mouse.ts.why: Pointer handlers receive cell coordinates, the event API every renderer shares.

src/renderers/dom/host/scroll-box.tsx.why: The scroller's API (scrollTop, scrollBy, viewport) is in rows and columns for callers shared with the terminal; content insets are given in cells.

src/renderers/dom/host/size-observer.ts.why: Observed sizes are reported in cells, as callers expect.

src/renderers/dom/host/style.ts.why: Maps the shared Box and Text props that components give in cells (width, height, padding, margin, gap, position) to pixels.

src/renderers/dom/host/surface-fit.ts.why: A chart takes its box when its cells come within a cell of it, because panes still count their space in cells.

src/renderers/dom/host/tabs.tsx.why: A tab strip is one row tall, the row every caller reserves for it.

src/renderers/dom/host/text.tsx.why: The ASCII wordmark draws one glyph per cell.

src/renderers/dom/input-host.tsx.why: The viewport is reported in cells (useViewport), the unit every renderer shares.

src/renderers/dom/native-renderer.ts.why: The renderer's width and height are reported in cells, the unit every renderer shares.

src/renderers/dom/styles.css.why: Defines the cell size and the base line height; status, footer and hint lines are one row; a few insets are one cell, as the terminal's (the floating pane's two-cell grip, a query bar segment).
